name: dogfood-multimodal-chat
description: Dogfood app (v1.15-4) — a multimodal Anthropic vision chat that exercises image upload (base64 + url), streaming response, cost tracking and multi-image comparison, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls Anthropic Messages API with image content blocks when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-lab/ai-llm createAnthropicMock with multimodal parts) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/ai-llm @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
